configDefinition.name: items
configDefinition.description: JSON array of content items, each with `uid` and `uri` (media URL). Video vs. image is detected from the file extension (e.g. .mp4 → video, .png → image). Required — the applet has nothing to play without it.

configDefinition.name: mode
configDefinition.description: Debug shows an on-screen diagnostic dashboard (device info, playback status, log console) during startup and whenever an error occurs, and plays full-screen the rest of the time; production always plays full-screen. Defaults to production.
